lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਦੇਵਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar phirahi devaaniaa ||
lines.translation: Engrossed in sexual desire, anger and egotism, he wanders around insane.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਤਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sir lagaa jam da(n)d taa pachhutaaniaa ||
lines.translation: When the Messenger of Death hits him on the head with his club, then he regrets and repents.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੈਤਾਨਿਆ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: bin poore guradev phirai saitaaniaa ||9||
lines.translation: Without the Perfect, Divine Guru, he roams around like Satan. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਕਪਟੰ ਰੂਪ ਕਪਟੰ ਧਨ ਕਪਟੰ ਕੁਲ ਗਰਬਤਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaj kapata(n) roop kapata(n) dhan kapata(n) kul garabatah ||
lines.translation: Power is fraudulent, beauty is fraudulent, and wealth is fraudulent, as is pride of ancestry.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਚੰਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਛਲੰ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਤੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)cha(n)t bikhiaa chhala(n) chhidra(n) naanak bin har sa(n)g na chaalate ||1||
lines.translation: One may gather poison through deception and fraud, O Nanak, but without the Lord, nothing shall go along with him in the end. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖੰਦੜੋ ਕੀ ਭੁਲੁ ਤੁੰਮਾ ਦਿਸਮੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pekha(n)daRo kee bhul tu(n)maa disam sohanaa ||
lines.translation: Beholding the bitter melon, he is deceived, since it appears so pretty

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਢੁ ਨ ਲਹੰਦੜੋ ਮੁਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜੁਲਈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: adh na laha(n)daRo mul naanak saath na julaee maaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: But it is not worth even a shell, O Nanak; the riches of Maya will not go along with anyone. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਸੰਜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaladiaa naal na chalai so kiu sa(n)jeeai ||
lines.translation: It shall not go along with you when you depart - why do you bother to collect it?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਤਨੁ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਵੰਜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis kaa kahu kiaa jatan jis te va(n)jeeai ||
lines.translation: Tell me, why do you try so hard to acquire that which you must leave behind in the end?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਿਐ ਕਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bisariai kiu tripataavai naa man ra(n)jeeai ||
lines.translation: Forgetting the Lord, how can you be satisfied? Your mind cannot be pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਰਕਿ ਸਮੰਜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhoo chhod an laagai narak sama(n)jeeai ||
lines.translation: One who forsakes God, and attaches himself to another, shall be immersed in hell.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਉ ਭੰਜੀਐ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: hohu kripaal daiaal naanak bhau bha(n)jeeai ||10||
lines.translation: Be kind and compassionate to Nanak, O Lord, and dispel his fear. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਚ ਰਾਜ ਸੁਖ ਮਿਸਟੰ ਨਚ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਮਿਸਟੰ ਨਚ ਮਿਸਟੰ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nach raaj sukh misata(n) nach bhog ras misata(n) nach misata(n) sukh maaiaa ||
lines.translation: Princely pleasures are not sweet; sensual enjoyments are not sweet; the pleasures of Maya are not sweet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਸਟੰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਮਿਸਟੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨੰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: misata(n) saadhasa(n)g har naanak daas misata(n) prabh darasana(n) ||1||
lines.translation: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is sweet, O slave Nanak; the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan is sweet. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਗੜਾ ਸੋ ਨੇਹੁ ਮੰਨ ਮਝਾਹੂ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: lagaRaa so nehu ma(n)n majhaahoo ratiaa ||
lines.translation: I have enshrined that love which drenches my soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਧੜੋ ਸਚ ਥੋਕਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਠੜਾ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: vidhaRo sach thok naanak mithaRaa so dhanee ||2||
lines.translation: I have been pierced by the Truth, O Nanak; the Master seems so sweet to me. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bin kachhoo na laagaee bhagatan kau meethaa ||
lines.translation: Nothing seems sweet to His devotees, except the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਸੁਆਦ ਸਭਿ ਫੀਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਨਉ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aan suaad sabh pheekiaa kar niranau deethaa ||
lines.translation: All other tastes are bland and insipid; I have tested them and seen them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਬਸੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: agiaan bharam dukh katiaa gur bhae baseethaa ||
lines.translation: Ignorance, doubt and suffering are dispelled, when the Guru becomes one's advocate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal man bedhiaa jiu ra(n)g majeethaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord's lotus feet have pierced my mind, and I am dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਭਿ ਝੂਠਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu praan tan man prabhoo binase sabh jhoothaa ||11||
lines.translation: My soul, breath of life, body and mind belong to God; all falsehood has left me. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਅਕਤ ਜਲੰ ਨਹ ਜੀਵ ਮੀਨੰ ਨਹ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੇਘ ਮੰਡਲਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: tiakat jala(n) nah jeev meena(n) nah tiaag chaatrik megh ma(n)dalah ||
lines.translation: Leaving the water, the fish cannot live; the rainbird cannot live without the raindrops from the clouds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਣ ਬੇਧੰਚ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਨਾਦੰ ਅਲਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: baan bedha(n)ch kura(n)k naada(n) al ba(n)dhan kusam baasanah ||
lines.translation: The deer is enticed by the sound of the hunter's bell, and shot through with the arrow; the bumble bee is entangled in the fragrance of the flowers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਚੰਤਿ ਸੰਤਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਨ ਨ ਰੁਚਤੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal racha(n)t sa(n)tah naanak aan na ruchate ||1||
lines.translation: The Saints are entranced by the Lord's lotus feet; O Nanak, they desire nothing else. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਖੁ ਡੇਖਾਊ ਪਲਕ ਛਡਿ ਆਨ ਨ ਡੇਊ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukh dekhaaoo palak chhad aan na deoo chit ||
lines.translation: Show me Your face, for even an instant, Lord, and I will not give my consciousness to any other.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਣ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਾਂ ਮਿਤੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jeevan sa(n)gam tis dhanee har naanak sa(n)taa(n) mit ||2||
lines.translation: My life is with the Lord Master, O Nanak, the Friend of the Saints. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu machhulee bin paaneeai kiu jeevan paavai ||
lines.translation: How can the fish live without water?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੂੰਦ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੋ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: boo(n)d vihoonaa chaatriko kiu kar tripataavai ||
lines.translation: Without the raindrops, how can the rainbird be satisfied?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਦ ਕੁਰੰਕਹਿ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naad kura(n)kahi bedhiaa sanamukh uth dhaavai ||
lines.translation: The deer, entranced by the sound of the hunter's bell, runs straight to him;

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਵਰੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸੁ ਕਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhavar lobhee kusam baas kaa mil aap ba(n)dhaavai ||
lines.translation: the bumble bee is greedy for the flower's fragrance; finding it, he traps himself in it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਅਘਾਵੈ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: tiu sa(n)t janaa har preet hai dekh daras aghaavai ||12||
lines.translation: Just so, the humble Saints love the Lord; beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, they are satisfied and satiated. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਵੰਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲੰ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਅਰਾਧਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: chitava(n)t charan kamala(n) saas saas araadhanah ||
lines.translation: They contemplate the Lord's lotus feet; they worship and adore Him with each and every breath.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਬਿਸਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਚੁਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: nah bisara(n)t naam achut naanak aas pooran paramesurah ||1||
lines.translation: They do not forget the Name of the imperishable Lord; O Nanak, the Transcendent Lord fulfills their hopes. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤੜਾ ਮੰਨ ਮੰਝਾਹਿ ਪਲਕ ਨ ਥੀਵੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: seetaRaa ma(n)n ma(n)jhaahi palak na theevai baaharaa ||
lines.translation: He is woven into the fabric of my mind; He is not outside of it, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸੜੀ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਪੇਖੰਦੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aasaRee nibaahi sadaa pekha(n)do sach dhanee ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the True Lord and Master fulfills my hopes, and always watches over me. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾਵੰਤੀ ਆਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਪੂਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaava(n)tee aas gusaaee pooreeai ||
lines.translation: My hopes rest in You, O Lord of the universe; please, fulfill them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਝੂਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil gopaal gobi(n)d na kabahoo jhooreeai ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Lord of the world, the Lord of the universe, I shall never grieve.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਸੂਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: dehu daras man chaau lahi jaahi visooreeai ||
lines.translation: Grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, the desire of my mind, and my worries shall be over.
